missingCompanyData.label: Legal company name
missingCompanyData.whyItMatters: Every statement, filing and CPA package must carry the exact legal name. Mismatches cause rejected filings and confused vendors.

missingCompanyData.label: EIN storage / reference architecture
missingCompanyData.whyItMatters: The EIN is a secret. The system stores only a vault reference id and never the EIN itself, so the reference must be provisioned before any document generation.

missingCompanyData.label: Business address
missingCompanyData.whyItMatters: Determines local tax/registration exposure and appears on every invoice, filing and Statement of Information.

missingCompanyData.label: Fiscal year
missingCompanyData.whyItMatters: The tax calendar, year-end close and every annual comparison depend on the fiscal year end. It must not be assumed.

missingCompanyData.label: Accounting method (cash vs accrual)
missingCompanyData.whyItMatters: Cash and accrual books produce different revenue, expense and AR/AP timing. The ledger cannot be interpreted correctly until the method is confirmed.

missingCompanyData.label: CPA identity
missingCompanyData.whyItMatters: Escalations, CPA packages and professional-guidance intake need a named professional to route to.

missingCompanyData.label: CPA responsibilities
missingCompanyData.whyItMatters: Whether the CPA files payroll returns, prepares the 1120-S, or only advises decides which obligations the system must track itself.

missingCompanyData.label: Bank accounts
missingCompanyData.whyItMatters: Every reconciliation and cash forecast starts from the list of accounts. Without it there is no cash position.

missingCompanyData.label: Cards
missingCompanyData.whyItMatters: Card spend is where personal and business mixing most often happens. Unknown cards mean uncategorized liabilities.

missingCompanyData.label: Payroll provider
missingCompanyData.whyItMatters: Payroll reports, tax deposits and filings are produced by the provider; the system reconciles against them and must know who files what.

missingCompanyData.label: Employee compensation (incl. the ~$8,000/month basis question)
missingCompanyData.whyItMatters: A figure without a basis (gross, net, contractor fee or employer cost) cannot be reconciled to payroll or forecast. The basis changes employer cost materially.

missingCompanyData.label: China worker classification
missingCompanyData.whyItMatters: Cross-border worker status drives withholding, documentation and possible foreign obligations. It is a professional decision, never an AI decision.

missingCompanyData.label: Invoicing process
missingCompanyData.whyItMatters: AR aging, revenue recognition and payment matching depend on when and how invoices are issued.

missingCompanyData.label: Customer entity
missingCompanyData.whyItMatters: The paying entity must be identified for contracts, related-party disclosure and information-return decisions.

missingCompanyData.label: Payment terms
missingCompanyData.whyItMatters: Terms define when receivables are overdue and shape the 13-week cash forecast.

missingCompanyData.label: Formal service agreement
missingCompanyData.whyItMatters: A related-party revenue stream without a written agreement is a disclosure and substantiation risk the CPA must know about.

missingCompanyData.label: Business insurance
missingCompanyData.whyItMatters: Insurance premiums are recurring prepaid expenses and workers' compensation coverage is tied to having employees.

missingCompanyData.label: Tax payment history
missingCompanyData.whyItMatters: Prior payments determine what is already satisfied and what is outstanding; the calendar is incomplete without them.

missingCompanyData.label: Prior tax returns
missingCompanyData.whyItMatters: Prior returns establish the accounting method, fiscal year, basis, depreciation history and carryforwards.

missingCompanyData.label: Opening balances
missingCompanyData.whyItMatters: The ledger cannot produce a balance sheet that ties to reality without confirmed opening balances.

missingCompanyData.label: Fixed assets
missingCompanyData.whyItMatters: Existing equipment must be on the register for depreciation and for the tax workpapers.

missingCompanyData.label: Loans
missingCompanyData.whyItMatters: Loans to or from the shareholder affect basis, interest and the balance sheet, and are related-party items.

missingCompanyData.label: Owner basis information
missingCompanyData.whyItMatters: Distributions beyond basis have tax consequences; the system cannot evaluate a distribution without basis data from the CPA.

missingCompanyData.label: Chart of accounts
missingCompanyData.whyItMatters: Categorization confidence depends on an agreed chart; the lab template is a proposal until the CPA confirms it.

missingCompanyData.label: Reimbursement rules
missingCompanyData.whyItMatters: Without rules the system cannot tell a legitimate reimbursement from a personal draw.

missingCompanyData.label: Approval thresholds
missingCompanyData.whyItMatters: Dollar thresholds decide when a proposed action needs the owner or a professional; defaults are placeholders until confirmed.
